layers.title: Layer 1 · Diaspora Mobile Client (Android Kotlin & iOS Swift)
protocols: Primary: AmneziaWG (obfuscated WireGuard with randomized magic headers H1–H4 and junk packet padding Jc/Jmin/Jmax)
Fallback: WireGuard-over-WSS (TLS TCP Port 443 WebSocket tunnel, auto-triggered if UDP handshake fails within 3.5 seconds)
clientGuards: Strict ::/0 IPv6 Sinkhole (prevents dual-stack Gulf 5G networks like STC, Mobily, e&, du from leaking real Saudi/UAE IPv6 addresses)
Encrypted In-Tunnel DNS (forces Egyptian DNS resolution inside the tunnel)

1-Tap 'Egyptian Apps Only' Split-Tunnel Preset (routes NBE, CIB, Banque Misr, InstaPay, Digital Egypt, Watch iT, My WE, Ana Vodafone via Egypt while keeping WhatsApp, Uber/Careem, and local Gulf bank apps on domestic internet)
Pre-Flight Banking Readiness Check (1-second check before launching a bank app verifying tunnel state, sticky IP match, IPv6 block, and warning if GPS permission is active)

layers.title: Layer 2 · Tier 1 Virtual Egypt Hub (Marseille MRS1 / Frankfurt FRA1)
layers.purpose: Handles 100% of Standard Tier traffic, high-bandwidth video streaming (Watch iT, ON Time Sports, Shahid Egypt), and general web browsing.

specs.subseaCableLatency: 28–32 ms from Marseille to Alexandria/Cairo via TE North & SEA-ME-WE-4/5 submarine cables
specs.ipSupply: Leased clean /24 AFRINIC/RIPE IPv4 subnet registered with an RFC 8805 GeoFeed (country: EG, city: Cairo) updated across MaxMind, ipinfo, IP2Location, and DB-IP
specs.legalAdvantage: Zero physical servers inside Egypt for general internet browsing — completely outside NTRA and Egypt Law 175 of 2018 territorial jurisdiction

layers.title: Layer 3 · Tier 2 Cairo Clean Egress Relays (Sticky 1:1 Banking & Gov IPs)
layers.purpose: Exclusively serves Banking Tier ($8.99/mo) subscribers and whitelisted Egyptian banking / .gov.eg destinations.

candidateProviders: Telecom Egypt WE Business Static Subnets (AS8452)
LightNode Cairo / IT EGY (Phase 0–1 VPS validation)
specs.ipPinning: 1 User : 1 Dedicated Static Egyptian IP pinned in the offshore PostgreSQL database. Never shared with any other subscriber.
specs.disklessRamMode: Runs entirely in RAM (tmpfs) with zero local disk persistence and zero subscriber PII on the node.
specs.nftablesAllowlist: Kernel nftables firewall strictly permits outbound HTTPS/TCP/UDP only to verified Egyptian bank ASNs and .gov.eg / .com.eg CIDRs. Blocks all general web browsing, SMTP mail ports (25, 465, 587), and BitTorrent/P2P.

layers.title: Layer 4 · Offshore Control Plane & 15-Minute Synthetic Status Engine
layers.purpose: Manages accounts, RevenueCat subscriptions, sticky IP allocation, live service status, and automated IP rotation.

specs.jurisdiction: Hosted in EU/US under an Offshore Corporate Entity (US Delaware LLC, UK Ltd, or UAE Dubai FZCO)
specs.syntheticProbes: Playwright / HTTP synthetic checks run every 15 minutes through each exit IP against digital.gov.eg, ppo.gov.eg, alahlynet.com.eg, banquemisr.com, cibeg.com, watchit.com, and te.eg
specs.reservePool: Maintains 25% warm spare IPs for instant automated rotation or 1-tap user self-swap

recommendedStructures: US Delaware or Wyoming LLC (via Stripe Atlas / Firstbase / Doola)
whyMandatory: Apple App Store Guideline 5.4 strictly prohibits individual developer accounts from submitting VPN apps using NEVPNManager / NEPacketTunnelProvider. Only verified Organization accounts are accepted.
Google Play VpnService policy requires an Organization developer account with verified business identity, a completed VpnService declaration form, and a video walkthrough.
Creates a clean legal and jurisdictional separation between the offshore software publisher and Egyptian telecom laws.

requirements: MASA Level 2 (Mobile Application Security Assessment) independent lab audit
At least 10,000 installs and 250 reviews on Google Play
At least 90 days live on Google Play with zero policy strikes
Transparent Data Safety section declaring encryption and zero data selling

egyptianLegalQuestions.statute: Law No. 175 of 2018 (Anti-Cyber and IT Crimes Law), Articles 1, 2 & 33
egyptianLegalQuestions.question: Does operating destination-allowlisted, stateless routing relays inside Cairo datacenters classify a foreign software company as a 'Telecom/IT Service Provider' required to retain user traffic logs for 180 days (under penalty of EGP 5–20M fines)?
egyptianLegalQuestions.architecturalMitigation: General internet browsing and streaming exit at our Marseille Virtual Egypt hub in France. Cairo Tier 2 nodes run diskless in RAM (tmpfs) with zero subscriber PII and enforce kernel nftables rules forwarding only encrypted HTTPS packets to whitelisted Egyptian bank ASNs and .gov.eg CIDRs.

egyptianLegalQuestions.question: Does terminating obfuscated AmneziaWG/WSS tunnels on rented servers in Cairo require a separate NTRA permit, or is the Tier III Cairo hosting provider's existing license sufficient?
egyptianLegalQuestions.architecturalMitigation: Contract exclusively with NTRA-licensed enterprise datacenters (Raya Data Center, Link Data Center, Telecom Egypt) and use standard HTTPS/TLS port 443 and UDP relays.

egyptianLegalQuestions.question: When the contracting company is a foreign entity (US LLC / UK Ltd / UAE FZCO) with no Egyptian office, employees, or local bank accounts, how do legal obligations split between the foreign entity and the local Cairo host?
egyptianLegalQuestions.architecturalMitigation: All user authentication, billing (RevenueCat), and account databases are hosted strictly offshore in EU/US cloud regions.

egyptianLegalQuestions.statute: Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020
egyptianLegalQuestions.question: How does Law 151 of 2020 treat subscriber account data if zero personal data is collected, processed, or stored on servers inside Egypt?
egyptianLegalQuestions.architecturalMitigation: Cairo relays never receive user emails, names, or billing identifiers—only rotating WireGuard public keys mapped in the offshore control plane.

egyptianLegalQuestions.question: What exact privacy policy disclosure satisfies both Apple/Google rules and Egyptian counsel without creating false-advertising liability?
egyptianLegalQuestions.architecturalMitigation: State clearly that we do not log browsing activity, never sell data to third parties, and use automated firewall rules to block network abuse.

egyptianLegalQuestions.question: What is the standard procedure when a Cairo datacenter receives an inquiry regarding a leased static IP, and how does our destination allowlist eliminate abuse risk?
egyptianLegalQuestions.architecturalMitigation: By blocking SMTP mail ports, BitTorrent, and all non-whitelisted destinations on Cairo relays, third-party spam or cybercrime cannot occur through our Egyptian IPs.

egyptianLegalQuestions.statute: B2B ISP Static IP Leasing Terms
egyptianLegalQuestions.question: Does leasing business static IP subnets from Telecom Egypt (WE), Vodafone, or Orange for dedicated 1:1 banking access require specific B2B rider clauses?
egyptianLegalQuestions.architecturalMitigation: Launch Phase 0–1 on Cairo enterprise cloud VPS + Marseille Virtual Egypt; add direct B2B ISP subnets in Phase 2–3 following counsel sign-off.
